page.layout: One printed page. A main text column on the right, with narrow marginal notes in the left margin. Below the text: a centred "FINIS." line, a heading "De natura opificis gloria", and a signature at the foot. The scan is rotated and the show-through from the reverse side is strong, so most lines cannot be read reliably.
page.notes: The page is rotated and the printed text is mostly hidden by show-through from the reverse side and by faint staining, so only the layout, the "FINIS." line, the heading "De natura opificis gloria" and the signature "D d 3" could be made out with any confidence. The body lines and the left-margin notes are marked illegible rather than guessed. The running head and page number are not legible. The stamp at the centre (a library stamp reading roughly "...GIA ... ENSIS") and the faint marks at the bottom edge were left out. The heading is a best reading and should be checked against a sharper scan.
